title: Roasted Butternut Squash and Apple Fattoush
changes_from_base: Roasted butternut squash, apple and radicchio replace the cucumber, tomato and lettuce for an autumn version.
summary: An autumn fattoush with roasted butternut squash, crisp apple and bitter radicchio, tossed with crunchy pitta and a lemon-sumac dressing.

ingredients.item: large pitta breads, split into thin rounds
fine sea salt or table salt, and pepper
butternut squash, peeled and cut into 1 cm cubes
fine sea salt or table salt
ground sumac, plus extra to serve
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Crisp the pitta
steps.text: Heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan). Brush the pitta rounds with oil, season and bake on a rack 8-12 min until golden. Cool.

steps.title: Roast the squash
steps.text: Turn the oven to 230 °C (210 °C fan). Toss the squash with oil and salt and roast 20-25 min, stirring once, until browned. Cool 10 min.

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.text: Whisk the lemon, sumac, garlic and salt, leave 10 min, then whisk in the oil.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Break the pitta into pieces and toss with the squash, apple, radicchio, parsley, spring onions and dressing. Dust with sumac and serve.

tips: Split the pitta into thin rounds for the crispest crisps.
Cool the squash before tossing so the radicchio does not wilt.
Dust with extra sumac at the table.
storage: Best eaten on the day. Keep any leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
